differential.name: Acute bacterial cystitis
differential.rationale: Common in elderly diabetics, documented as active condition, explains urinary findings.

differential.name: Acute pyelonephritis
differential.rationale: May develop from untreated cystitis, presents with systemic signs and can worsen renal function.

differential.name: Urosepsis
differential.rationale: High‑risk patient (CKD, diabetes, alcohol use) can progress to sepsis from urinary infection.

differential.name: Obstructive acute kidney injury (e.g., urinary retention/stone)
differential.rationale: Can precipitate rising creatinine in CKD and mimic infection‑related decline.

differential.name: Drug‑induced interstitial nephritis
differential.rationale: Elderly patients on multiple meds may develop renal inflammation presenting with AKI and urinary symptoms.
